title: Self-assembly of heteroleptic tetranuclear carboxylate complexes of yttrium and lanthanides during hydrolysis and oxidation of rare earth homoleptic carboxylates

synthesis.procedure: Under argon Schlenk conditions, yttrium diphenylacetate (164 mg, 0.055 mmol) was dissolved in 10 mL of THF with heating, the solution was cooled to room temperature, and air was bubbled through it for 16 h. The mixture was diluted with THF to 15 mL and 80 mL of petroleum ether was added to precipitate the product. The solid was filtered and dried in vacuo to give a white powder. The crystal lattice contains one free octane molecule from petroleum ether that is lost on vacuum drying. The complex was also first isolated as colorless crystals while attempting to grow crystals of [Y(Ph2CHCOO)3(THF)]n.
synthesis.temperature: heated to dissolve, then room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk flask; air bubbled through THF solution
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Diluted to 15 mL with THF, precipitated with 80 mL petroleum ether, filtered and dried in vacuo. Single crystals contain one lattice octane molecule lost on drying.

No preparative quantities or reagent amounts are given for 4; deliberate air oxidation of 2 in THF instead afforded 4a.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Blue crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were picked from the mother liquor. Crystallographic formula includes two lattice n-alkane/hexane molecules excluded by SQUEEZE.

synthesis.procedure: Under argon Schlenk conditions, [Nd(Ph3CCOO)3(THF)3] (335 mg, 0.274 mmol) was dissolved in 10 mL of THF and air was bubbled through the solution for 16 h. The mixture was diluted to 15 mL and 80 mL of hexane was added for slow diffusion over 5 days, giving a pale blue powder and crystals. Crystals were separated by washing with mother liquor. The unit cell contains three free THF molecules that are lost on vacuum drying. The crystal model is a disordered superposition of mu3-peroxide and mu3-oxide ligands.
synthesis.time: 16 h air bubbling, then 5 days diffusion
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk flask; air bubbled through THF solution, then hexane diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Diluted to 15 mL, layered/diffused with 80 mL hexane for 5 days; crystals washed with mother liquor. Three lattice THF molecules are present in the crystal and lost on drying.

properties.summary: An IR band at 818 cm^-1 was assigned to nu(O-O); no magnetic or luminescence data are reported.
